blocks.content: Create a program where two classes inherit from a single class.

items: Create a class named Polygon with the display() function.
Inside the function, print A Polygon is created.
Inherit two classes named Rectangle and Triangle from the same Polygon class.
Inside main(), create an object of the Rectangle class.
Call the display() function of using the object of Rectangle class.
Create an object of the Triangle class and call the display() function using its function.
